cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. As venue manager, will you approve storing Tuesday's rain in this cup? The wedding needs a dry lawn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

mechanism: A confidently directs formal approval of a weather-storage plan, authorizing stranger measures as the manager raises practical concerns.
confusable: Unlike merely telling an impossible story, A seeks a signature and adapts the absurd mechanism to cover the manager's second wedding.
comparison: Storing future rain and sealing it with drought differ from a confidence-supported museum landing.
seedUse: The seed already has A explaining as the superior expert and directing signature despite B's formal venue authority.
